rows.abstract: A QUALIFIED SENIOR CITIZEN SHALL BE ENTITLED TO THE TWENTY PERCENT  (20%) TAX EXEMPTION FROM THE FINAL WITHHOLDING TAX ON INTEREST INCOME FROM PHILIPPINE CURRENCY BANK DEPOSIT: PROVIDED, THAT ONLY FIVE HUNDRED THOUSAND PESOS (P500,000.00) MAXIMUM AMOUNT OF DEPOSIT SHALL BE ALLOWED FOR THE EXEMPTION; PROVIDED FURTHER, THAT A SENIOR CITIZEN WHO AVAILS THIS EXEMPTION SHALL BE REQUIRED TO SUBMIT HIS/HER LIST OF BANK DEPOSITS INCLUDING BANK CERTIFICATIONS ATTESTING THE AUTHENTICITY OF HIS/HER DEPOSIT FOR PURPOSES OF FINAL COMPUTATION AS TO THE MAXIMUM AMOUNT OF DEPOSIT REQUIRED FOR EXEMPTION.

rows.author: C006
rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING CERTAIN SECTIONS OF EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 561 DATED SEPTEMBER 21, 1979 CREATING THE COMMISSION ON THE SETTLEMENT OF LAND PROBLEMS (COSLAP) BY ENLARGING ITS COMPOSITION, SUPPORT STAFF, EXPANDING AND STRENGTHENING ITS FUNCTIONS, POWERS AND JURISDICTION AND FOR SUCH OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: Rationale: The Commission on the Settlement of Land Problems (COSLAP) was created primarily to extend assistance to small farmers, tillers, settlers, indigenous cultural minorities and the underprivileged in settling their land problems in the mostexpeditious and inexpensive way. In the process, it also relieves the courts of the clogging of land problems cases. In order to effectively implement and execute its decisions  and render justice without unnecessary delay, there is a need for COSLAPto be granted the necessary powers vested in courts, such as the contempt power.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on JUSTICE since 1999-06-03

rows.author: C006
rows.title_full: AN ACT REQUIRING DEVELOPERS OF INDUSTRIAL ESTATES TO ALLOCATE AT LEAST EIGHTEEN PERCENT (18%) OF THE TOTAL AREA OF THE ESTATE AS OPEN SPACE FOR GREENBELTS, MINI-FORESTS OR PUBLIC PARKS PLANTED WITH TREES, PROVIDING FINES AND OTHER ADMINISTRATIVE SANCTIONS FOR VIOLATIONS THEREOF, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: Developers of industrial estates shall allocate at least eighteen percent (18%) of the total land area of the estate, exclusive of roads, service streest and alleys, for greenbelts and mini-forests or public parks planted with trees for the enhancement of the environment and at the same time serving as resting places for the people around it. No application for the devleopment of an industrial estate shall be approved by the appropriate government agency unless this provision has been compliedwith. For the purpose of this Act, INDUSTRIAL ESTATE shall refer to areas designated or intended for the development of factories and warehouses.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on NATURAL RESOURCES since 1999-06-03
